reading.title: The False Return
reading.intro_zh: 这篇短文不复述原文，而是换到现代电子商店的退货柜台：侦探从收据和库存不一致发现问题，最后揭开串通的关系，提醒我们购物再方便，也不能省去诚实。
passage: On Saturday afternoon, a store detective checked the self-checkout records in a large electronics shop. One expensive speaker was missing, but the computer showed only a cheap charger. The camera showed a boy scanning the charger twice while a young assistant quietly put a sealed parcel behind the returns counter. Ten minutes later, the boy came back with the parcel and asked for a refund. The assistant tried to help him as quickly as possible. The detective asked to open the parcel and found the speaker inside. He soon found out that the assistant was the boy's elder brother. Both boys were arrested. The temptation to steal had looked easy, but honest shopping still means paying for what is in the parcel.

questions.question: What made the store detective suspicious?
options: A speaker was missing, but the computer showed only a cheap charger.
The boy was repairing the shop camera.
The assistant had already paid for the speaker.
The shop was busier than ever before.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文开头说一只 expensive speaker 不见了，但系统只显示 cheap charger，这个 mismatch 让侦探起疑。

questions.question: What did the camera show?
options: The detective wrapped the parcel himself.
The boy paid for an expensive speaker.
The boy scanned the charger twice while the assistant moved a parcel.
The assistant returned the speaker to the shelf.
questions.explanation_zh: camera showed a boy scanning the charger twice，同时 assistant quietly put a sealed parcel behind the returns counter。

questions.question: What was inside the parcel?
options: A cheap charger.
An expensive speaker.
A broken camera.
A receipt for two parcels.
questions.explanation_zh: 侦探 asked to open the parcel and found the speaker inside，说明包裹里是 expensive speaker。

questions.question: What hidden relationship explained the trick?
options: The detective was the boy's brother.
The shop owner was the boy's teacher.
The assistant was the boy's elder brother.
The camera belonged to the boy's family.
questions.explanation_zh: 最后 detective found out that the assistant was the boy's elder brother，这解释了为什么 assistant 会帮忙。

questions.question: What is the moral point of the passage?
options: A false return can make expensive goods into free gifts.
A family member in a shop may give away anything.
Convenience does not remove the need to be honest and pay.
A camera is useful only when the shop is crowded.
questions.explanation_zh: 结尾说 honest shopping still means paying for what is in the parcel，方便购物不等于可以不诚实。

writing.intro_zh: 今天抓五个 Lesson 32 的核心结构：用 not so...as...once were 做今昔比较，用 greater than ever before 强调问题变大，用 fewer...than usual 解释观察更容易，用 as quickly as possible 写异常速度，再用 found out that 揭示隐藏真相。

patterns.title: not so ... as ... once were
patterns.source: People are not so honest as they once were.
patterns.focus_zh: 这个结构把现在和过去比较，表达“不像从前那样……”。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写人们、顾客或学生现在不像过去那样有耐心、安静、诚实或小心。
patterns.sample: Some customers are not so patient as they once were in busy shops.
patterns.tip_zh: not so 后面接形容词，as they once were 放在比较的后半部分。

patterns.title: greater than ever before
patterns.source: The temptation to steal is greater than ever before.
patterns.focus_zh: greater than ever before 用来强调某个问题比过去任何时候都更大。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写在大商店、自助付款或网络购物中，某种诱惑或责任比以前更大。
patterns.sample: The temptation to skip payment is greater than ever before at self-checkout.
patterns.tip_zh: greater 修饰抽象名词很自然，比如 temptation, pressure, responsibility。

patterns.title: fewer ... than usual
patterns.source: There were fewer people in the shop than usual.
patterns.focus_zh: fewer...than usual 用来比较数量，说明这一天和普通情况不同。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写店里、车站或教室里的人比平常少，并说明这让某件事更容易发生。
patterns.sample: There were fewer shoppers than usual, so the detective could watch carefully.
patterns.tip_zh: fewer 修饰可数名词，比如 people, shoppers, students，不要用来修饰 money。

patterns.title: as quickly as possible
patterns.source: The assistant wrapped it up for her as quickly as possible.
patterns.focus_zh: as quickly as possible 表示尽可能快；在故事里，这个速度暗示动作背后有目的。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写一个店员、同学或工作人员尽快完成某个动作，但句子要让读者感觉这个速度有原因。
patterns.sample: The assistant packed the expensive headphones as quickly as possible.
patterns.tip_zh: as quickly as possible 通常放在动作后面，说明动作完成得很快。

patterns.title: found out that ...
patterns.source: The detective found out that the shop assistant was her daughter.
patterns.focus_zh: found out that 用来写“发现隐藏真相”，很适合故事结尾的反转。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写侦探、老师或工作人员最后发现了隐藏关系或真正原因。
patterns.sample: The manager found out that the assistant was helping his cousin.
patterns.tip_zh: that 后面接完整句子，把真正发现的内容说清楚。
